classifiedFinding.title: Dust loss in _updatePool's rewardBudget decrement when reward * ACC_PRECISION / totalStaked rounds the per-share delta to zero

classification.assetImpact: Sub-wei reward loss to stakers per call; cumulatively negligible at realistic phUSD magnitudes.
attackPath: 1. Adversarial caller repeatedly triggers _updatePool with very small elapsed values.
2. At realistic configs the rounding loss is zero. With pathological configs (totalStaked near 1e18, sub-wei rewards), residue is bounded by the dust-handling branch in _safePay.

classifiedFinding.justification: Low / QA. Per C4 guidance, dust-amount rounding losses are QA. Acceptable as-is — the dust-handling branch in _safePay (lines 513-518) absorbs the residue cleanly per the M-01 fix.
